sentences.text: The present writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the constitution read with section 482 Cr.P.C. for issuance of appropriate directions to the respondents for grant of parole for a period of 03 months.
2. Issue notice.
3. Ms. Nandita Rao, Additional Standing Counsel assisted by the Investigating Officer SI Sudhir Dahiya, P.S. Aman Vihar, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent/State.

4. The petitioner was convicted for the offences punishable under sections 302/376 IPC vide judgment dated 30.07.2018 and vide order on sentence dated 31.07.2018, he was sentenced for imprisonment to life along with fine of Rs.3,000/- for each of the offences punishable under sections 302/376 IPC and in default to undergo simple imprisonment for 03 months.
5. The criminal appeal bearing no. 536/2019 filed by the petitioner was dismissed vide judgment dated 19.09.2022 passed by the Division Bench of

sentences.text: The petitioner filed an application/representation on 08.08.2023 to the DG, Prison for grant of parole and the said application/representation has not yet been decided by the respondent/State.

7. The Additional Standing Counsel for the State/respondent stated that the application/representation of the petitioner for grant of parole shall be decided within a period of 02 weeks in accordance with law and rules and regulations.

8. Accordingly, in view of the submissions made by the Additional Standing Counsel for State/respondent, the respondent/State is directed to dispose of/decide the application/representation filed on behalf of the petitioner for grant of parole, in accordance with law and rules and regulations, thereafter, intimate the petitioner within one week positively.
9. The present petition along with pending applications, if any, stands disposed of.
10. Copy of this order be given to the Additional Standing Counsel for the State/respondent for doing the needful and further action.
11. The petitioner shall be at liberty to initiate appropriate legal proceedings in case of altered circumstances.
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J SEPTEMBER 19, 2023 N/AK
